The canonical contract describes required boundaries and checks, not their successful execution. Existing assertion, source, remote and browser receipts retain their own immutable scope.

Detailed original classifications, source denominators and the canonical mapping are retained in docs/publication-contract-details.json. Canonical mixed authority never promotes machine extraction or model-derived assertions to official authority.

Repository publication uses reviewed PR merge. The learning Pages workflow renders tracked public Markdown and, only when explicitly declared, copies bounded retained evidence archives from the exact successful protected-main validation commit. It deploys that single built artefact; it never rebuilds or copies an unlisted evidence corpus.

Real-browser verification remains required. browser-evidence-check validates retained observations offline; it does not launch a browser, repeat the journeys or attest a later application deployment. Historical pilot journeys retain their earlier content and application-identity limitations.
Console errors must be absent or explicitly recorded and justified in the retained observation; an undocumented error cannot pass the documented-allowlist policy.
Rights evidence URLs locate repository documentation on main; they are not immutable source snapshots. Original source hashes and licence evidence remain in the named frozen inventories.
Sensitivity is conservatively not-assessed: no claimant files are acquired, but this metadata repair does not establish an exhaustive personal-data review of public guidance or project research.

The original project-authored and pinned-consumer command labels describe origin rather than review. They map to unreviewed; existing reviewed-local-guidance labels are preserved only for the prior AGENTS.md commands.

The 20 September additive increment preserves frozen source/runtime releases. Fresh listing metadata is not a fresh PDF-body verification; reference-only legal metadata is not substantive legal evidence.

The household candidate adds bounded statutory body evidence without closing the 203 recorded obligations. Earlier model trials and browser observations retain their exact source and engine bindings; fresh candidate verification is separate.

Retained evidence archives require a Git-bound publication declaration and input/output hashes. Their exporter commit is declared review provenance; the offline publisher checks the approved module hashes rather than fetching or independently attesting a remote Explorer checkout. Delivery integrity is not legal applicability, specialist acceptance or AI answer correctness.

The additive logical-unit build separates page locations from bounded retrieval units, retains source byte accounting and treats automatic boundaries as uncertain. No service default or specialist acceptance is implied by generating these projections.

The source-led pipeline is additive. Its retained source-declared structures, scoped guide conventions, unit proposals and compact discovery cards do not imply complete semantic modelling, specialist approval, new source capture or deployment of a service.

The source-led manual guide is generated into the static learning site from committed Markdown by the existing learning-site renderer. Publication and browser acceptance remain exact-commit checks; generated HTML is never authored directly.

The separate structured-context/location-migration.json ledger distinguishes exact source-location overlap, restored navigation and explicitly inferred associations. It retains all 40 original staff requirements and 203 open obligations without asserting semantic equivalence or complete answerability.

CI keeps every legacy replay step in a separate job and runs the source-led checks independently. The existing protected validate check runs after both jobs and fails unless both succeeded; Pages still requires the whole exact-commit workflow to succeed.

The original custody acceptance migration has its own source-bound ledger and evaluation, separate from the 40 staff occurrences. A source-read profile, retained historical scope or complete declared passage does not establish all legal qualifications or a correct AI answer.
